Title: TOM: Q: The Treatment and Torpor

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
What happens when The Treatment damages its target Prince
while the Prince is empty in torpor?

I assume that nothing happens, a la the Charnas ruling.

Is there a general ruling that (non-agg) damage done in torpor
beyond the healing capabilities of the vampire is ignored
(ignore all non-agg damage once the vampire in torpor is empty)?

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
L. Scott Johnson <sjoh...@math.scarolina.edu> wrote:
>What happens when The Treatment damages its target Prince
>while the Prince is empty in torpor?
>I assume that nothing happens, a la the Charnas ruling.

Correct.

>Is there a general ruling that (non-agg) damage done in torpor
>beyond the healing capabilities of the vampire is ignored
>(ignore all non-agg damage once the vampire in torpor is empty)?

If a vampire in torpor takes more damage than it has blood, it loses whatever
blood it had left but is otherwise unaffected, unless the damage was
aggravated, yes.
